name: schisandrin b
summary: Lignan from Schisandra chinensis with potent hepatoprotective and mitochondria-supporting activity. Among the best-studied Schisandra lignans with both preclinical and human liver function data.
description: Schisandra lignan (schisandrin B) with redox- and stress-response relevance; preclinical hepatoprotection motivates study, but clinical translation remains constrained.
safetyNotes: Schisandra-type lignans can affect drug-metabolizing enzymes/transporters; caution with complex medication regimens.
